topic: Techniques and Challenges in Cycle-Accurate Architectural Simulation for Multithreaded Workloads on Multicore SoCs
topic_description: The topic focuses on the techniques and challenges associated with cycle-accurate architectural simulation of multicore System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, particularly in the context of multithreaded workloads. It explores whether conventional assumptions of cycle-accurate simulation remain valid under heavily multithreaded conditions, with an emphasis on methods such as sampling. Functional simulation is excluded from the scope of this discussion.
